divergences.declared: Container environment supplies modern OpenSSL 3.x / base libraries
divergences.actual: Compiled binary contains hardcoded legacy primitive: MD5 (.rodata:MD5_IV@0x00000178)
divergences.impact: Static linking or legacy embedded routines bypass host/container security updates.
divergences.remediation: Recompile binary artifact against shared OpenSSL 3.x and remove embedded legacy routines.
